overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the executive session notice topic "Value of Land - Couper Farm, 180 Great Road" gave enough detail for a Purpose 6 real-property discussion, though more detail would have helped.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged that seven executive session notices on Couper Farm, a property, were too vague because they did not disclose the board planned to discuss a Host Community Agreement.
allegations.key_passage: Although additional information would have been useful to the public, we find that the executive session topic listed on each meeting notice, "Executive Session-Value of Land- Couper Farm, 180 Great Road," provided the public with sufficient detail of the closed door discussions under Purpose 6.
